title: Planet Selection
description: The ways a player picks a planet: for a card effect, for a structure, a planet or technology, a planet outcome in a vote, and planets to exhaust when paying.

shots.heading: A card asks for a planet
shots.caption: Mining Initiative: candidate planets are ringed on the map and the bar names the card and what will happen. Planets that cannot be chosen are dimmed.

shots.heading: After choosing on the map
shots.caption: Clicking Lodor on the map selects it. The bar now reads "Mining Initiative — mine Lodor (3R/1I)" with Confirm and Cancel; the other candidates stay available as chips.

shots.heading: Planet first, then the structure
shots.caption: When several options share a planet, picking the planet turns the bar into one button per structure: place a PDS or a space dock on Jord.

shots.heading: A planet or a technology
shots.caption: Bio-Stims can ready a planet on the map or an exhausted technology. Technologies appear as chips in the same bar.

shots.heading: Voting for a planet
shots.caption: An Elect Planet agenda has planets as outcomes, so the vote is cast by choosing a planet on the map.

shots.heading: Paying: exhausting planets
shots.caption: The payment drawer lists the ready planets and what each is worth against what is owed (5 resources).

shots.heading: Paying: the drawer is minimised
shots.caption: To pick on the map the drawer is minimised to the Resume decision pill. The payable planets are not highlighted here, unlike a card pick.

shots.heading: Paying: a planet picked on the map
shots.caption: Clicking the planet token for Jord on the map selects it. The map itself shows no sign of the selection.

shots.heading: Paying: staged in the drawer
shots.caption: Reopening the drawer shows Jord ticked and 4 of 5 resources staged, with the remainder still to pay.

notes.title: Map clicks
notes.text: A click on a hex opens the system inspector as well as selecting; a click on the planet token itself is what selects a planet for payment.

notes.title: Gap
notes.text: Payment has no map highlighting or confirm bar, so picking planets on the map for payment is much less discoverable than for card picks.
